clock.sampling: Actual model endpoints at approximately 10 Hz, plus final endpoint; no synthetic/interpolated physics samples.

provenance.rawTraceIntegrity: All five compressed and decompressed traces checked against the pinned Phase 7 retention inventory.

labels.agc: Authentic retained Luminary 099 execution: output packets, CDU readbacks and readiness registers.
labels.model: Modern external synthetic rigid-body/IMU fixture: quaternion, angular rate, torque and gimbals.
labels.gimbals: [O,I,M] = outer/inner/middle, degrees, from C=Ry(I) Rz(M) Rx(O).
labels.torque: Body [P,Q,R], newton-metres; effective 1 m lever arm, synthetic inertias.
labels.alpha: Body [P,Q,R], radians/second squared, including Euler angular-momentum coupling.
labels.cdu: Actual AGC counters [032,033,034] (octal addresses), unsigned 15-bit angle counts; quantum 360/32768 degrees.
labels.rcs: Frame rcs=[channel005,channel006] packet latches applied during that model interval; exact new packet timings are in rcsEvents.
labels.readiness: Actual diagnostic memory readback, not a decoded DSKY display; cycle gives readback age.
labels.limits: No descent, terrain, landing, calibrated flight fidelity, live piloting or full three-axis control demonstration.

cases.title: Yaw · connected feedback
cases.initialConditions: fresh CPU+model, zero physical rates, identity orientation, genuine delayed P00/V77 fixture
notes: Recorded experiment replay. Controls select playback; they do not command a live AGC.
Only yaw and pitch control were validated; roll motion from rigid-body coupling is retained.
Physical evolution freezes at the horizon. Authentic CPU and queued sensor operations then settle; settlement is not attitude stability.
Quaternion, rates, torque and gimbals are simulated fixture outputs, not historical Apollo flight telemetry.
CDU words and readiness are held from the latest recorded readback; null means no readback yet.
